def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in g[r])]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    colors = [v for row in g for v in row if v != 2]
    background = max(set(colors), key=colors.count)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2, background)]
    if not points:
        return g
    if horizontal:
        divider = horizontal[0]
        top, bottom = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
        shift = divider + 1 - top if top > divider else divider - 1 - bottom
        out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
        out[divider] = g[divider][:]
        for r, c in points:
            nr = r + shift
            if 0 <= nr < h:
                out[nr][c] = g[r][c]
        edge = bottom + shift + (1 if shift < 0 else -1)
        if 0 <= edge < h:
            out[edge] = [8] * w
        return out
    if vertical:
        divider = vertical[0]
        left, right = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
        shift = divider + 1 - left if left > divider else divider - 1 - right
        out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][divider] = 2
        for r, c in points:
            nc = c + shift
            if 0 <= nc < w:
                out[r][nc] = g[r][c]
        edge = right + shift + (1 if shift < 0 else -1)
        if 0 <= edge < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][edge] = 8
        return out
    return g
